todos.scope: All 16 Eventi e Sagre path prefixes; full heading and older card-only layouts
todos.problem: Page-wide selectors read related-event municipalities and publisher footer addresses, skip the actual card dates and most hour syntax.
todos.acceptance: 31 stdlib tests pass; replay 17/17 same documents, no footer address and no related-event municipality; card-only legacy page remains readable. Network and activation policy unchanged.

todos.scope: Eventi e Sagre adapter -> RawMarket -> CleanMarket -> source evidence -> export
todos.problem: Source edition intervals, archive state, source modification time, calendar qualifiers and conflicts now exist in the pure parser but have no complete storage bridge.
todos.implementation: Extend the adapter models and explicit source evidence mapping; preserve edition archive state separately from the market entity. Keep import/read/content/event dates distinct.
todos.acceptance: Round-trip an archived weekly announcement without generating future openings; retain all original calendar bounds and source hashes/read dates; a past edition never deletes the market or claims permanent closure.

todos.scope: Luogo / Giorni di svolgimento / Orario repeated body blocks
todos.problem: The Pescara sample contains five blocks but four distinct address/day/hour rows. A single RawMarket cannot represent them safely.
todos.implementation: Consume source_rows through existing market identity, ISTAT geography and cohort collision controls; preserve stable existing market IDs and attach evidence only to the matched row.
todos.acceptance: Four distinct rows survive, a duplicate source block does not create a fifth market, and a header address or day cannot be propagated to another venue.

todos.scope: Addresses and calendars expressed in long narrative paragraphs
todos.problem: The bounded parser deliberately does not turn every street/programme reference into the market venue. Examples include a piazza described relative to a basilica and programmes with multiple activities/locations.
todos.implementation: Add evidence-backed sentence/label formats only after a second sample establishes attribution to the main market. Separate a venue from a route or accessory activity.
todos.acceptance: The additional grammar recovers the intended main-market field without importing a concert/workshop location, related-event date or publisher footer address.

todos.scope: Legacy listing URL selection and category filters
todos.problem: The legacy SECTIONS map targets seven Mercatini categories; 93 catalog records / 88 URLs belong to hobbisti creativi, Natale or Eventi prefixes outside those target categories. Eventi links are rejected by the Mercatini-only listing filter.
todos.implementation: Keep these existing URL families in source-format coverage. Decide admission from evidence that the page represents a market, not from its category name. Do not enable a bulk crawler as an audit side effect.
todos.acceptance: All 16 present path prefixes are classified; Eventi/Sagre/Festival pages cannot silently become ordinary weekly markets.

todos.scope: Event JSON-LD bound to the same source event ID
todos.problem: 12/17 sampled JSON-LD blocks are not valid strict JSON. Midnight / 23:59:59 endpoints describe edition boundaries, not opening hours.
todos.implementation: Reject invalid JSON-LD as evidence, use the exact visible event card, compare valid same-ID metadata and flag contradictions.
todos.acceptance: Invalid JSON-LD does not break a valid visible card; another event's JSON-LD does not contribute fields; date endpoints never become market hours.

todos.scope: All /mercatini/{slug} URLs, with monthly, selected editions, seasonal and bounded-span variants
todos.problem: No production Cose di Casa reader exists in the current repository; the legacy pipeline call is commented. Four of five current samples have precise market hours absent from the catalog.
todos.implementation: Create a pure scoped field adapter for mercatini-mostre-address, mercatini-mostre-times, mercatini-mostre-date-big and labelled suspension rows. Keep author/organizer links as verification leads, not opening confirmation.
todos.acceptance: Fixtures cover all five observed semantic variants, contain no raw publisher HTML, and distinguish field extraction from source reading and verification.

todos.scope: Recurrence text, previous-day coupling, edition ranges, selected days and suspensions
todos.problem: Generic mensile does not preserve an explicit edition list, the Saturday before the second Sunday, summer selected Fridays or a daily summer span.
todos.implementation: Represent the complete calendar rule and explicit edition intervals; preserve month exclusions and exceptions before any forecast. Do not reconstruct missing dates from monthly as a bare label.
todos.acceptance: Bologna includes the preceding Saturday, Cernobbio retains only listed Fridays, Venice retains five separate ranges, and unspecified extra-edition years remain unknown.

todos.scope: Visible calendar versus Event JSON-LD and suspension labels
todos.problem: Bologna/Todi JSON-LD dates equal the reading day and conflict with the visible monthly rule. Venice has edition/suspension conflicts. Fiumicino has different summer bounds in its structured fields and narrative.
todos.implementation: Add conflict states and retain field provenance from both source sections. Never prefer JSON-LD merely because it is structured; require source-level resolution before publishing a disputed schedule.
todos.acceptance: No 19 October opening is inferred for a Sunday market; no disputed summer span is expanded; suspension rows labelled Prossime date are not interpreted as closures.

todos.scope: Market hours embedded in mercatini-mostre-times prose
todos.problem: Precise hours occur in prose, with integer, comma-minute and 24:00 notation. The same block may also include hours of an accessory activity.
todos.implementation: Extract the main-market hour statement with its context, preserve sunrise/sunset or partial-hour precision, and avoid copying workshop/game/music times into the market field.
todos.acceptance: Bologna 08:30–18:00, Venice 09:00–19:00, Cernobbio 08:00–19:00 and Fiumicino 18:00–24:00 are detected; Cernobbio's 10–18 activity is not substituted, and Todi's sunset is not converted into an invented clock time.

todos.scope: Requested legacy URL, canonical HTML URL, source modification and transport metadata
todos.problem: The Cernobbio saved source URL differs from the current canonical/JSON-LD URL. The read_file channel does not expose an observed HTTP redirect. All five examples expose article:modified_time, absent from catalog source-date fields.
todos.implementation: Keep requested, canonical and observed final transport URL as separate evidence and bind canonical changes to the same place/event identity. Carry source-modified time separately from read/import dates.
todos.acceptance: No redirect is claimed from a canonical tag; no editorial modification timestamp is stored as a market occurrence or personal verification date.

todos.scope: Per-layout source -> parser -> normalization -> snapshot -> export
todos.problem: A non-empty catalog field does not establish correctness, while a missing field can mean source absence, reader omission, ambiguity, policy hold or loss in normalization.
todos.implementation: Persist a field-retention checklist with those distinct outcomes and attach sample/version evidence. Include footer-address candidates and ungrounded generic recurrences in the review queue without per-record overwrites.
todos.acceptance: Report supported source formats, observed field presence, parser retention and verified data as separate measures. Completion of a parser task never marks the storage bridge or all source records as verified.
